query:
UPDATE leadSequenceQueue
SET scheduledFor = DATE_ADD(scheduledFor, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey = 'day_3_spots_filling'
  AND status IN ('scheduled','processing');

UPDATE leadSequenceQueue
SET scheduledFor = DATE_ADD(scheduledFor, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey = 'day_6_last_call'
  AND status IN ('scheduled','processing');

SELECT touchKey, COUNT(*) as affected, MIN(scheduledFor) as earliest, MAX(scheduledFor) as latest
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey IN ('day_3_spots_filling', 'day_6_last_call')
  AND status IN ('scheduled','processing')
GROUP BY touchKey;
